figurative_meaning_en: Out of fear of rebuke or scolding
similar_in_english: out of fear of one's life
example_sentences_in_bangla: মুখের ভয়ে সে কোনো কথা বলল না।
মুখের ভয়ে ছেলেটি সত্যি কথা লুকিয়ে রাখল।
example_sentences_in_english: Out of fear of rebuke, he didn't say a word.
Out of fear of scolding, the boy hid the truth.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on maintaining harmony by avoiding confrontation or criticism.
